messages:
alex: Heads-up: need quick sync on pricing add-on for Priority Credits. Enterprise POC wants guaranteed route priority + soft onboarding cap flexibility. Can we align on must-haves before biz-dev meeting tomorrow?

mika: What do you mean by 'Priority Credits' exactly? Per-request priority tokens, a monthly pool, or both?

raj: From runtime perspective we can do QoS tokens that map to a priority queue. Cost here is roughly +1.2x GPU/CPU accounting per token on avg. We'll need a hard cap on concurrent high-priority tokens per customer.

ben: Finance note: prefer a minimum commit/term for priority SLAs. Suggest 6mo minimum commit or $X equivalent. For pilots, we can offer a 3mo softcap at a discounted rate that auto-evaluates.

sophie: Legal: we need explicit SLA language, fallback policy (what happens when priority can't be honored), and audit/logging obligations. Softcap needs a clear overage billing clause.

alex: I pushed a quick draft clause for discussion: ```If customer exceeds the softcap more than two months in any rolling three-month window, Redwood may invoice at the committed enterprise rate or require an amendment to the contract.``` Thoughts?

sophie: Wording tweak: replace 'may invoice' with 'may invoice or pursue a mutually agreed amendment' and add a 30-day notice period before rate changes. Also call out data residency for Private deployments requiring separate addendum.

raj: Tech caveat: priority path requires model-variant compatibility (we can't guarantee priority across incompatible quantized variants). We'll need model-pinning or automatic compatible-variant fallback to avoid regressions during rollouts. That affects rollout complexity.

mika: Sales asks: customers also want burst credits for launches. Can we bundle a monthly X credits + an on-demand top-up purchase? We should also surface a usage meter in Console showing remaining priority credits.

ben: Meter + top-up is fine. Proposed tiering (quick sketch): Starter: no priority pool; Pro: 100k credits/month; Enterprise: custom pool with SLA and rollover option. Top-up pricing to be defined.

alex: Proposed launch criteria — all must be green before pilot: 1) runtime QA: priority path meets 95th-percentile latency SLO for a representative workload, 2) billing + console meter implemented, 3) contract language signed off by Legal + Finance. If green, pilot target start = in ~2 weeks.

raj: I'll own runtime QA. ETA 11 days. Need a test harness that simulates priority spikes + mixed-normal traffic. @ops-bot please provision a test cluster with GPUs.

ops-bot: allocating cluster rg-prod-test-03 (4x A100), retention 14d — created :white_check_mark:

mika: I'll prepare the customer pitch and terms. Can someone confirm suggested top-up price bands so I can present ARR impact? @ben

ben: I'll put together price bands and expected ARR lift by EOD and post in this thread.

alex: :thumbsup: If no objections, I'll lock the companion doc (product/priority-credits/ draft) and send to BD after Ben's bands and Sophie's final wording.
